title: kate-ui: open, save, and close documents from the window
summary: The window can make a document, open a path, save, and close. A modified document refuses to close. An untitled save asks for a path. This packet starts only after PKT-0015 is merged. The file-effect tests do not import GPUI. Linux CI runs those tests.

lane.reason: files.rs is pure Rust and its tests run on Linux. The open and save panels compile only on macOS. The rust (macos-15) check is the GPUI build evidence. The owner must look at both panels on his Mac.

definitions.definition:
#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum FileRequest {
    New,
    OpenPath(std::path::PathBuf),
    Save,
    SaveAsPath(std::path::PathBuf),
    Close,
}

#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum FileEffect {
    Ready,
    NeedsPath,
    RefusedModified(kate_core::DocumentId),
    OpenFailed,
    SaveFailed,
    AlreadyOpen,
    UnknownView,
}

pub fn apply_file_request(ws: &mut kate_core::Workspace, view: kate_core::ViewId, request: FileRequest) -> FileEffect

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Do not start this packet until PKT-0015 is on main. Rebase onto that commit and keep mod keys. lib.rs adds mod files with no cfg gate. New calls new_document and new_view. OpenPath calls open and new_view. A load error or a binary file returns OpenFailed and adds no document. An already open path gets another view. Save runs Command::Save. NoFile returns NeedsPath. SaveAsPath runs Command::SaveAs. AlreadyOpen returns AlreadyOpen. Close runs close_view. RefusedModified leaves the view in the workspace. session.rs keeps command_for_binding. It handles Command::Save by calling apply_file_request. NeedsPath calls App::prompt_for_new_path and then SaveAsPath. cmd-o calls App::prompt_for_paths with files true, directories false, and multiple false, then OpenPath on the first path. cmd-shift-s calls prompt_for_new_path. cmd-n calls New. cmd-w calls Close. A refused close does not show a sheet. Add a File menu for those five actions. Do not edit keys.rs or paint.rs. Do not add a dependency. A new Rust file starts with the GPL-3.0-or-later SPDX header.

regression_tests.name: files::tests::save_as_writes_the_bytes
regression_tests.asserts: SaveAsPath writes the buffer bytes into a temp file. A later Save keeps those bytes. The test builds the temp directory with std::fs and does not use the process home.

regression_tests.name: files::tests::save_of_untitled_needs_a_path
regression_tests.asserts: Save on a document with no path returns NeedsPath. The document stays open and unsaved.

regression_tests.name: files::tests::close_refuses_a_modified_document
regression_tests.asserts: Close on the only view of a modified document returns RefusedModified. The view is still in the workspace. Close of an unmodified view removes it.

regression_tests.name: files::tests::missing_path_does_not_open_a_document
regression_tests.asserts: OpenPath of a missing file returns OpenFailed. The document count does not change.
